_comment: Finish-the-Unfinished sprint (#1424) frozen ceilings, census 2026-07-16; unscoped_repo_reads added 2026-07-17 (ADR-079 D2b warn-mode baseline, pre-calibration). Counts may only go DOWN; lower the ceiling in the same commit as the fix. See tests/test_completion_ratchets.py. mypy_* keys: #1436 slice 2026-08-08 extended the gate from 4 codes to EVERY code mypy emits (closes #1469 — [name-defined] was filtered out while being a guaranteed-runtime-NameError class; its ceiling is 0 and stays 0). The 4 original mypy ceilings were re-measured in that census: resolving the 16 dangling forward refs exposed 13 previously-invisible arg-type errors (services/database/models.py +7, services/api/todo_management.py +6) — pre-existing drift made visible — and the slice's fixes still brought arg_type in below its old 405 ceiling. 2026-09-11 (#1436 CI-red fix): attr_defined 190->149 -- github_adapter's 62 "str has no attribute get" errors were one wrong annotation (collection endpoints typed as Dict), fixed via _call_github_api_list; index/var_annotated/misc lowered to their measured values. NOTE: arg_type's ceiling was MIS-SET to 378 on 2026-08-31 (21ca0944c) when CI measured 379, and 0dfa06452 subtracted a correct -1 delta from that wrong base, reaching an unreachable 377; it is now reachable because 2 real arg-type errors were fixed in protocol_client. Set ceilings from a MEASURED count in the CI-pinned venv, never from base-minus-predicted-delta. 2026-09-13 (#1436, ten red pushes): assignment 245->241 and return_value 50->49 -- pure shrink-direction, the #1759/#1767 deletions removed 4 [assignment] (conversation/conversation_handler.py -2, intelligence/conversation_aware.py -2) and the #1762/#1776 render+gather fixes removed 1 [return-value] (intent_service/canonical_handlers.py). CI was NEVER over ceiling in that window. ⚠️ THE TRAP, and it cost a whole session: the gate reads ~75 errors HIGHER in the 228-package dev venv/ than in the 15-package CI venv, because ignore_missing_imports=True types every unresolvable third-party import as Any and suppresses that module's downstream errors -- notion_adapter +70, staging_health +26, semantic_indexing +4, none of them touched in months. Running the gate under venv/bin/python manufactures a 9-code phantom over-ceiling report (index 63 vs 44, union-attr 181 vs 156, operator 83 vs 73) that no commit can explain and no fix can clear. ALWAYS measure with venv-mypy-gate/ (scripts/bootstrap-mypy-gate-venv.sh); scripts/run-sweep.sh ratchets now refuses to run the gate any other way. 2026-09-23 (#1856): call_overload 11->9 and index 43->39 -- MEASURED by scripts/run-sweep.sh ratchets in venv-mypy-gate/. ⚠️ ATTRIBUTION NOT ISOLATED, stated rather than assumed: this was measured in a worktree that ALSO held another agent's in-flight #1574/#1575 edits, so the drop may be theirs, not #1856's. Neither code is flagged in either file #1856 touched (canonical_handlers.py, portfolio_service.py). If #1856 lands WITHOUT that other work, re-measure before keeping this line: a ceiling lowered on someone else's uncommitted fix is unreachable in CI. RESOLVED 2026-09-23 (Lead): re-measured in a throwaway worktree at the clean HEAD holding #1574/#1575/#1856 and NOTHING in-flight -- index 39, call_overload 9, identical to the in-tree reading, so the drop is attributable to the committed set (not the then-uncommitted #1556/#1577 work);  2026-09-23 (#1576): silent_death_core 193->192 -- MEASURED by scripts/check_silent_death.py in the worktree. Attribution isolated: the ONLY other uncommitted work in that tree was #1533, whose diff is confined to tests/intent/contracts/test_multiuser_contracts.py, and collect() skips any path with 'tests' in its parts -- so it cannot move this count. The -1 is services/intent_service/canonical_handlers.py's try/except around datetime.now(ZoneInfo(config_tz)), deleted when _handle_temporal_query stopped reading the config file's timezone. #1576 also removes a broad except from google_calendar_adapter._get_user_timezone (now delegating to datetime_utils.user_timezone_name) and adds one to that new getter, but BOTH are annotated silent-ok, so neither touches the unannotated count -- net -1, not -2, and the arithmetic is stated because  Same commit: unscoped_reads 48->46. Attribution VERIFIED by measurement, not inference -- a throwaway detached worktree at clean HEAD reads 48/193, the working tree reads 46/192, and diffing the two --list outputs names the exact two removed hits: both are services/intent_service/canonical_handlers.py load_standup_config (global config file), in _handle_temporal_query and _handle_agenda_query. Those two reads WERE the audit-F2 'config-tz labeled' face defect -- a per-user answer taking its timezone from a per-deployment file -- so the ratchet drop and the user-facing fix are the same edit. A THIRD load_standup_config remains in the guidance handler (~:4155) and is deliberately left: its time_context face is wrong in a different way (server-naive current_hour under a config label) and correcting it changes time-of-day greeting behavior across _format_*_guidance --  Same commit, mypy: assignment 234->231 and index 39->37, both MEASURED in venv-mypy-gate/ via scripts/run-sweep.sh ratchets. index -2 is the same two deleted load_standup_config subscripts ('Value of type any? is not indexable'); the third remains at canonical_handlers.py:4153, which is why this is -2 and not -3. assignment went UP first, to 235: #1576's new calendar_context['free_blocks'] = [...] tripped a dict[str, bool] inferred from the literal's lone True. Fixed at the site rather than absorbed -- annotating calendar_context as Dict[str, Any] cleared that one AND four pre-existing siblings (1408/1420/1433/1438), hence 235 -> 231. Recorded because a naive reading of the delta (-3) would suggest #1576 removed three assignment errors; it added one and removed four. 2026-09-23 (#1522 legs 3+4): dark_templates 19 and dark_assets 10 added -- MEASURED by the new census functions in tests/test_completion_ratchets.py (templates/ reachability from python .html literals via Jinja include/extends edges; asset basenames vs templates+web+services corpus). Both allowlists pin the exact set; disposal is #1522's Rule-0 item with Arch. 2026-09-23 (#1868): unscoped_reads 46->45 -- MEASURED by scripts/check_unscoped_reads.py in the worktree. This is the THIRD load_standup_config the #1576 note above named and deliberately left in the guidance handler (~canonical_handlers.py:4155, now removed): _handle_guidance_query no longer reads the config file's deployment-wide standup timezone at all -- current_hour and the printed face are both derived from one `now_in_zone(await user_timezone_name(user_id))` call, same pattern as the #1576 temporal/agenda fixes.
